description: Count Elastic Security detection alerts by rule and host since a given time. Use this to check whether a situation report claim is backed by alerts.

configuration.query: FROM .alerts-security.alerts-* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?since | STATS alerts = COUNT(*) BY kibana.alert.rule.name, host.name | SORT alerts DESC | LIMIT 50

since.description: Start of the window in ISO 8601 format
